summary.text: Anthony Carbines has been the Labor member for Ivanhoe in the Legislative Assembly since 2010 and a minister since 2021. He was Minister for Police from 2022 to 2026, and his current portfolios include economic development, major events, medical research, racing, and AI and the digital economy. He is recontesting Ivanhoe in 2026.

prior_roles.role: Minister for Artificial Intelligence and the Digital Economy, Major Events, Medical Research and Economic Development
Minister for Community Safety and Minister for Victims
Minister for Disability, Ageing and Carers, and for Child Protection and Family Services
Chief of staff to Education Minister Bronwyn Pike

prior_roles.note: Wikipedia says five years, without dates.

summary.text: Ben Milne is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Ivanhoe at the 2026 Victorian election. He works in a local supermarket, rents his home and belongs to the Retail and Fast Food Workers' Union. He says he has spent years as a community organiser and union activist, including in anti-racism campaigns and in support of Palestinians.

prior_roles.organisation: Retail and Fast Food Workers' Union

priorities.text: I believe in a society that puts people above profit
Tackling rising inequality and the cost of rent, mortgages and groceries
Restoring community services that have closed

sources.title: Ivanhoe: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Dora Bergman is standing as an independent for Ivanhoe at the 2026 Victorian election, on the VEC's list of nominations. A Dora Bergman stood as an independent in Chelsworth Ward of Banyule City Council in 2020, winning 2.7% of the first-preference vote; no source confirms it is the same person. Neither the ABC nor a campaign page had published a biography as at 9 Nov 2026.

summary.text: Michelle Kennedy is running for Ivanhoe as an independent at the 2026 Victorian election, endorsed by Voices of Jagajaga, a group she helped found and was secretary of. She has taught maths, science and chemistry at secondary level for about ten years, and was president of her Australian Education Union sub-branch from 2020 to 2024. Her earlier jobs were in health care, among them managing a psychiatric practice.

priorities.text: At least 15 per cent of new homes built in the electorate next term to be public housing
Replacing stamp duty with an annual tax on land value
An end to fossil fuel projects approved by the Victorian government
Neighbourhoods where shops, parks and transport are a short walk away

summary.text: Nina Crawley is the Greens candidate for Ivanhoe at the 2026 Victorian election. She leads advocacy and campaigns at Oxfam Australia and earlier worked as a teacher. She says Ivanhoe is where she has lived and worked and brought up her family.

occupation.text: Advocacy and campaigns lead, Oxfam Australia

Directing investment to the people and places most in need

summary.text: Oscar Lopez Rios is the Liberal candidate for Ivanhoe at the 2026 Victorian election. He moved to Australia from Colombia at the age of 17, more than 22 years ago, and has built a landscaping business in Melbourne's northern suburbs. He trained in landscaping and horticulture at TAFE and also has a bachelor's degree in business management.

priorities.text: Safer streets, backing the Liberal pledge of 3,000 more police and 200 more protective services officers
Safer buses and trains in the Ivanhoe area
